title: Regular-register configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $m$ Boolean work tapes, let $s$ be a state, let $r$ be one of the work-tape indices, and let $f\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and $p\in\mathbb{Z}$. The regular-register configuration has state $s$, the same input-head position and output as $c$, tape contents $f$ and head position $p$ on tape $r$, and the same contents and head positions as $c$ on every other work tape.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with $m$ Boolean work tapes and state set $\Lambda$
